top_concerns: No imaging performed to rule in/out biliary obstruction
Missing full liver panel and bilirubin fractionation
Hemolysis work‑up not ordered despite anemia
Over‑emphasis on CKD as a primary cause of hyperbilirubinemia
review_summary: The differential correctly prioritizes biliary obstruction but overstates CKD and omits a hemolysis work‑up. Key laboratory and imaging data are missing, limiting certainty. Adjusted probabilities reflect obstruction as the dominant likely cause, with cardiac congestion, drug injury, and hemolysis as secondary considerations.
